name: lci_config
description: LCI /config CBOR vectors (spec 17.5.2): GET responses and PUT update payloads emitted by ConfigResource, plus rejection cases reflecting its verified behavior (4.01 unauthenticated writes, 4.00 for empty/malformed/non-map/duplicate-key/tagged/trailing-byte bodies and unknown keys).

vectors.name: get_spec_example_config
vectors.description: GET /config response matching the spec 17.5.2 example document.

vectors.name: get_empty_config
vectors.description: Fresh node with no configuration set returns an empty CBOR map.

vectors.name: get_name_only
vectors.description: Minimal configuration carrying only the node name.

vectors.name: get_role_leaf
vectors.description: Leaf role value from the spec role enumeration.

vectors.name: put_partial_update_changed
vectors.description: PUT /config partial update (spec 17.5.2 example) merges into existing state.

vectors.name: put_multi_key_update_changed
vectors.description: PUT /config updating several known keys in one request.

vectors.name: get_unicode_node_name
vectors.description: Edge: non-ASCII node name encodes as UTF-8 CBOR text string.

vectors.name: get_large_integer_value
vectors.description: Edge: integer above uint8 encodes with CBOR extended length.

vectors.name: put_unauthorized_when_writes_disabled
vectors.description: PUT /config without transport authentication returns 4.01; state unchanged.

vectors.name: put_empty_payload_bad_request
vectors.description: Empty PUT body is rejected 4.00 before CBOR parsing.

vectors.name: put_non_map_cbor_bad_request
vectors.description: A well-formed CBOR array is rejected 4.00 because updates must be a map.
vectors.note: encoded_hex of a list is pinned only as the malformed request body.

vectors.name: put_unknown_key_atomic_reject
vectors.description: Unknown key rejects 4.00 atomically; no field from the body is applied.

vectors.name: put_trailing_bytes_bad_request
vectors.description: Valid CBOR map followed by trailing bytes is rejected 4.00.

vectors.name: put_duplicate_keys_bad_request
vectors.description: Duplicate map keys are rejected 4.00 instead of last-one-wins.

vectors.name: put_tagged_value_bad_request
vectors.description: CBOR-tagged values (tag 29) inside the update map are rejected 4.00.
